automated.summary: All four required vitest leaves for selection-ui execute and pass, each proven with an executed-count check rather than a bare exit code: every required id runs exactly ONE leaf (tests=4, skipped=3, failures=0), while a nonexistent id runs NONE (tests=4, skipped=4) - so the ids name real, executing leaves and the reported green is not the runner's no-match false pass. python3 factory/scripts/verify.py passed after each delegated round (structural, typecheck, quality, test), and npm run build:frontend is part of the task's verify commands.

frontend/src/lib/api.test.ts (the new data methods' CSRF bootstrap, cookie credentials and one-shot 401 refresh)

functional.summary: Live E2E on the host against the real client data. Signed in as admin@example.invalid with the mock OTP, reached MIS Reports from the now-enabled nav item, and ran Agriculture/Nursery/DUB/2026-07-01 against the ingested July SAP actuals (SAP Entries Mapping.xlsx#SAP Report, 4,113 rows). The resolved branch renders end to end: the scope readout names 7 cost centres, 28 GL codes and nursery-mis-financial-v1; totals show Actual Rs 1,15,12,712.07; 28 governed GL rows render with the month as 'Jul 2026' and the % measure as its designed label 'over-budget' (0 occurrences of NaN on the page); and the unmapped-GL bucket renders as a reviewable list of 9 triples, each carrying an Actual and a Budget amount plus its reason ('GL absent from Sheet1', 'Sheet1 says Tertiary while SAP books Primary'). The first pass FAILED on two rendered defects - the month cell showed the IST-shifted ISO timestamp 2026-06-30T18:30:00.000Z (the wrong month) and every % cell showed NaN - both fixed through delegated rounds and re-verified live here. A third delegated round closed four design-fidelity gaps against the imported prototype.
non_blocking_findings: The period select shows raw ISO dates ('2026-07-01', '2099-11-01') because the options route returns the ISO date as the label and the page renders the label verbatim by design; the label belongs to the already-merged selection-resolver (task 2), ledgered as D-0028.
'2099-11-01' is a genuine stray month in the client's SAP workbook, not a rendering artifact - it surfaces real source data quality.
residual_risks: The Budget side is Rs 0.00 everywhere because the budget workbook cannot be ingested on the host: mis-budget.parser.ts cellText() calls toISOString() on an Invalid Date produced by exceljs for one cell in Nursery MIS Format.xlsx, so the ingest throws RangeError: Invalid time value. Budget rendering is proven structurally (every table row and every bucket row shows a Budget amount) but not with non-zero live values. Ledgered as D-0027.
The unresolvable branch is not walked live - the single-selection master makes it unreachable from the UI - and is proven by the component test, exactly as the approved plan states.

The vitest required_test gate cannot fail closed on a drifted leaf name (a bogus -t exits 0 with tests=4 skipped=4). For this task the four leaves are proven by demonstrated control: each required id executes exactly ONE leaf (tests=4 skipped=3 failures=0) and a nonexistent id executes NONE. Ledgered as D-0029 alongside D-0024.
